notes: The owner, twice, and the second time settled it: *"if you are comparing two different fields both from FMP and saying they are not consistent, then its you that misunderstands the fields you are looking at"* — and then *"we had decided that we would only treat sharadar as just another set of time series data with its own prefix and we would stop trying to resolve whether its right or wrong."* Two comparisons are retired in this release. Neither was a bug. Both were category errors that had been running long enough to produce records, withhold fields, and shape a whole module's design. A trail
